parts.name: EngineBlock
parts.description: Cast-iron 06A block, bore 81.0 mm, stroke 86.4 mm, 1781 cc. Stays in the car.

parts.name: CylinderHead
parts.description: Aluminium 20-valve head (3 intake, 2 exhaust per cylinder), DOHC, belt + chain cam drive.

parts.name: CamCover
parts.description: Cast cylinder-head cover with coil wells and oil filler neck.
parts.fastener_note: 9 x M6 nuts (Pelican Parts Golf IV 1.8T valve cover article).

parts.name: OilSump
parts.description: Pressed-steel oil pan with drain plug. Simulated: cracks and leaks.
parts.fastener_note: 20 x M6 flange bolts placed evenly (approximate count) + M14 drain plug.

parts.name: TimingBeltCover_Upper
parts.description: Plastic upper timing-belt cover over the camshaft sprockets.

parts.name: TimingBeltCover_Lower
parts.description: Plastic lower/centre timing-belt cover behind the crank pulley.

parts.name: CrankPulley
parts.description: Vibration damper / poly-V crank pulley.
parts.fastener_note: 4 x M8 Allen bolts (Torx/Allen) on the hub.

parts.name: AuxiliaryBelt
parts.description: Poly-V accessory belt: crank, A/C compressor, alternator, power-steering pump.

custom.tool: 16 mm spanner on the belt tensioner

parts.name: AccessoryBracket
parts.description: Cast bracket on the front of the block carrying alternator, A/C and PAS pump.

parts.name: EngineCover
parts.description: Plastic '1.8T' engine cover over the cam cover and fuel rail.

parts.description: Air filter housing with lid, panel filter and MAF sensor on the outlet.

parts.description: Rubber hose from MAF to the turbo compressor inlet.

parts.description: Cast intake manifold: 4 runners into a plenum, throttle body on the left end.

parts.name: ExhaustManifold
parts.description: Cast-iron 4-into-1 manifold, turbo flange underneath.

parts.name: Turbocharger
parts.description: KKK K03-type turbo (K03s on the 180 PS RS). Wastegate actuator rod adjusts boost.
parts.fastener_note: 3 x M10 bolts to manifold; support bracket 1 bolt; oil return 2 bolts; oil feed + 2 coolant banjo bolts (Pelican Parts Golf IV 1.8T turbo; banjo count approximate).

custom.boost_setting: Wastegate rod length; stock K03 ~0.8 bar, K03s (RS) ~1.0 bar
